role: Gate: replays the oracle's PlaceProbe cases (placer pose, stack, target cell, side, hit vector) through csrc/engine/place.c's place_try and checks the return, stack after, every block write in order, drops, tile entities, Det states and 3x3 chunk hash per case, then every field of the final region.

structs.name: splitref
structs.java: one Det split stream (determinize.sh static RNG name) per role

structs.name: ref
structs.java: the oracle's Det start.txt/end.txt snapshot (netherite.oracle.Det: world seed, per-role nextId, seeder/math digests, split streams)

structs.name: writes
structs.java: the block writes one case recorded

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/place. Native calls: place_set_case, place_try (csrc/engine/place.h), te_render, det_* including det_split_find for Item.itemRand, nbt_parse/nbt_diff, probe.h helpers (hash_around, cmp_final, chunk_bytes), world_*. Reads manifest.json, cases.bin, writes.bin, drops.bin, tileentities.bin, shapes.bin, startchunks.bin.gz, watch.bin.gz, digest.txt.gz, final.bin.gz. One of the LONG tests the Makefile starts first. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/PlaceProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/place/big2, big42, dbl. writes/te field names summarised.
